[1/2] Plan: document the format= and missing= filters the photos row omitted, and extend ReadmeApiTest to cover every _narrowing parameter

impact_assessment.why: Two filters shipped and are documented in feature bullets, but the photos API row never listed them, so an integrator cannot find them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Complete filter reference; a test stops a future filter from landing undocumented; no runtime change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, docs and tests only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: README sits at its size cap.
impact_assessment.mitigation: compact table prose while keeping every contract detail, verify the guard fails without the fix, run all four gates.

Task 'docs-photo-filters' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: also retire damage when a later full check re-reads the file and does not report it again, so a fix done in File Explorer clears the panel

impact_assessment.why: The panel only cleared damage on a re-upload; a file repaired directly on disk stayed listed forever next to a check summary of 0 damaged.
impact_assessment.benefits: Both real repair paths clear the panel; still-damaged files stay listed; no schema.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/integrity damaged list is narrower again; dependency: none; concurrency: RLock; state: relies on check writing damaged events before its summary.
impact_assessment.mitigation: five-case matrix probe, regression test for the still-damaged case, ADR-074 update, gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Disk repair clears: 322 tests OK; 4/4 gates; five-case matrix correct; still-damaged file stays listed; checklists: passed
Task 'integrity-disk-repair' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: answer HEAD like GET without a body, stop _send_file streaming on HEAD, and keep a download token unspent on a HEAD probe

impact_assessment.why: The handler had no do_HEAD so every HEAD was a 501, though _send already branched on it; enabling it exposed a whole-file stream and a burnt one-time download token.
impact_assessment.benefits: Standards-correct HEAD for gallery, JSON, originals, previews and downloads; no wasted I/O; download links still work once.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HEAD now 200 with headers, download token no longer spent by HEAD; dependency: none; concurrency: token read under the existing lock; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for each fault, live socket probes for framing and ranges, ADR-076, gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] HEAD done: 326 tests OK; 4/4 gates; five paths match GET status+Content-Length with no body; ranges match; download token survives a HEAD; checklists: passed
Task 'head-semantics' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: close the connection when a file shrinks after stat(), so a promised Content-Length cannot leave a keep-alive client hanging

impact_assessment.why: A file replaced or truncated between stat() and open() sent fewer bytes than the Content-Length promised, with no frame terminator; the client blocked until the socket timeout.
impact_assessment.benefits: A truncated transfer ends with a clean EOF the client reports as IncompleteRead; no hung connections.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, only the already-broken short-send path; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: deterministic test that shrinks the file right after stat(), verified failing without the fix, gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Short send closes: 327 tests OK; 4/4 gates; without the fix the client hung to a timeout, with it gets IncompleteRead; checklists: passed
Task 'shrink-close-connection' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: treat a person's folder name as taken when that folder exists on disk, for both rename and create

impact_assessment.why: free_folder only checked the profiles table, so a leftover folder made a rename fail with a misleading WinError 5 message and let a new person adopt untracked files.
impact_assessment.benefits: Renames onto leftovers succeed with Name (2); new people start empty; no schema change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: create() and free_folder() gain a root argument; dependency: none; concurrency: same lock; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for both paths, single create_person entry point, ADR-077, gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Disk-aware folders: 329 tests OK; 4/4 gates; both tests fail without the fix and pass with it; checklists: passed
Task 'folder-name-disk-check' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: give each write_atomic call its own temp file so two writers on one path cannot steal each other's bytes

impact_assessment.why: The temp name used only the pid, so concurrent writes to one path shared a temp file; the first replace took the other's bytes and the loser raised FileNotFoundError.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every atomic write owns its temp file; concurrent writes both land; no stray temps.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none, temp names only; dependency: none; concurrency: exactly the case being fixed; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: probe that reproduced the error before the fix, a deterministic test on temp names, ADR-078, gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Unique temp files: 330 tests OK; 4/4 gates; two-thread probe went from 1 error to 0 with no leftover temps; checklists: passed
Task 'atomic-temp-unique' completed successfully.
